summary: Backend for #63 delegation is done and committed; the whole UI layer (D11-D15) is not started.
digest: Done (committed in wip checkpoints): D1 schema columns plus migration, D2 auth policy appearance.assign with advocatesCanAssign, D3 validators, D4-D7 core delegation domain (assign, reassign bulk, unassign, suggest, view, barrel, core-domains registry and docs), D8 cross-tenant service registry and cases, D10 server actions with cross-tenant-actions probes, and core/validators/auth tests. Not done: D11 tomorrow/plan/page.tsx, D12 delegate-sheet, assignee-chip and outcomes-live-strip, D13 i18n delegation namespace (en, ta/kn stubs, catalog test), D14 packages/ui delegation pattern plus Storybook stories, D15 Playwright e2e/visual/a11y specs, and the link from tomorrow/page.tsx. Also not run: the final validate commands, forgedock check, implementation.md and the self-review. The existing .forge-lean/result.json and implementation.md were stale from an earlier unrelated lane. The UI work (about 5 new surfaces with i18n, stories and e2e) is larger than the remaining 20 turns. Recommendation: retry as a narrower lane covering only the UI deliverables D11-D15 on top of this branch, since the backend is ready to build on.
